scope: Exact listed MP1/MP2/WMA v1/v2 source tuples, ASF framing metadata, independent scalar reference and reset/preroll seeks. No container or playback admission implied. Source binaries stay in scratch storage.
resetReferenceNote: WMAv1 noise-table state resets: seek PCM is compared independently with scalar FFmpeg decoding of the same WAVEFORMATEX/block sequence; full-stream noise variation is retained with SNR.
